name: platform-skills
description: Practical guidance for platform engineers across Claude, Codex, Cursor, and Copilot: Kubernetes (baseline, RBAC, workload hardening, debug), GitHub Actions (design, security, review, debug), Azure (Workload Identity, tagging, AKS, RBAC), OpenShift (SCC, Routes, GitOps, upgrades), Secrets (ESO, Sealed Secrets, rotation, audit), Kyverno, Helm, Terraform, Flux CD (Flux Operator, OCI delivery), Argo CD, AWS (CloudFront, WAF, Lambda@Edge, IAM, IRSA), Gateway API (ingress-nginx migration), Linkerd, Linux, networking, MCP development, observability, SOC 2 compliance, PR review, PR triage, KEDA, Karpenter, cluster upgrades (EKS version rollback), progressive delivery (Flagger), backup and DR (Velero), FinOps (Infracost, cost tags, OpenCost), supply chain security (Cosign, SBOM, SLSA), Kubescape posture (NSA, MITRE, CIS, SOC2), Falco runtime security, Chaos Engineering, DORA Metrics, LLM Observability (Datadog LLMObs), and animated docs. Every answer includes blast radius, validation steps, and rollback plan.

gitops_engine.title: GitOps engine
gitops_engine.description: flux, argocd, or none. Skills write examples for this engine first.

primary_cloud.title: Primary cloud
primary_cloud.description: aws, azure, gcp, or multi. Skills lead with this provider's commands and services.

aws_profile_convention.title: AWS CLI profile naming
aws_profile_convention.description: How your AWS CLI profiles are named, for example <env>-workload-<team>. Used in printed aws commands. A naming pattern only: never a credential or key.

required_tag_keys.title: Required tag keys
required_tag_keys.description: Comma-separated tag and label keys every resource must carry, for example owner,cost-center,environment. Used by finops and review checks.

github_org.title: GitHub organisation
github_org.description: Your GitHub organisation, used in workflow, CODEOWNERS and OIDC examples.
